O R D E R (Order of the Court was made by The Hon'ble Chief Justice)
The petitioner seeks a direction against the respondents to instruct all manufacturers of food materials packed and sold within the State of Tamil Nadu to put details of product in Tamil.
2.On a query, the petitioner, appearing in person, is not able to point out any provision of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, nor the regulations made therein, requiring the same to be done.
In our view, this is a matter purely within the domain of the executive functioning and it is for the executive authorities to act in accordance with law.

No directions in this behalf can be issued in a P.I.L.
3.Writ Petition, accordingly, stands closed.
